C_COD_CAUSES_DIAGNOSED.rationale: The response identifies two of the three causes (charging the discount rather than the remainder, and reading only the first coupon code) along with remedies. However, it fails to diagnose the second cause (a coupon exceeding the discounted total driving the amount owed negative); in fact, it treats a negative amount owed (-10) as a valid outcome in its corrected implementation example. Because it diagnoses some causes but fails to identify all three, it exceeds Level 1 but falls short of Level 3, meriting a score of 2.
